synopsis: At a quiet seaside hotel, a guest discovers that one locked room has a story nobody agrees on.
grammarFocus: Past narration · imperfect, preterite and pluperfect
coverImagePrompt: Moody seaside boutique hotel at night in Galicia with dark corridors brass room number twelve and ocean mist

sentences.es: El hotel Miramar estaba casi vacío cuando Daniel llegó al pueblo una noche de noviembre.
sentences.en: The Miramar Hotel was nearly empty when Daniel arrived in town one November night.

sentences.es: Había viajado hasta la costa para ordenar las fotografías que su padre le dejó después de morir.
sentences.en: He had traveled to the coast to sort through the photographs his father left him after his death.

annotations.explanation: The pluperfect describes travel completed before the story’s main past timeline.

examples.es: Ella había viajado antes de cumplir veinte años.
examples.en: She had traveled before turning twenty.
We had already left when he arrived.

sentences.es: Su padre había sido fotógrafo y, durante años, había visitado aquel hotel en invierno.
sentences.en: His father had been a photographer and had visited that hotel in winter for years.

sentences.es: La recepcionista, una mujer llamada Rosa, le entregó la llave de la habitación once y le deseó buenas noches.
sentences.en: The receptionist, a woman named Rosa, handed him the key to room eleven and wished him good night.

sentences.es: Mientras subía las escaleras, Daniel observó que la puerta de la habitación doce no tenía número.
sentences.en: As he climbed the stairs, Daniel noticed that the door to room twelve had no number.

annotations.explanation: The imperfect subía sets an ongoing scene; observó is the interruption.

sentences.es: En su lugar había una marca rectangular, más clara que el resto de la madera.
sentences.en: In its place was a rectangular mark, lighter than the rest of the wood.

sentences.es: Esa madrugada, un sonido lo despertó: alguien arrastraba una silla al otro lado de la pared.
sentences.en: In the early hours of the morning, a sound woke him: someone was dragging a chair on the other side of the wall.

sentences.es: Daniel esperó unos minutos y salió al pasillo, pero todas las luces estaban apagadas.
sentences.en: Daniel waited a few minutes and stepped into the hallway, but all the lights were off.

sentences.es: A la mañana siguiente le preguntó a Rosa si alguien dormía en la habitación contigua.
sentences.en: The next morning he asked Rosa whether someone was sleeping in the adjoining room.

sentences.es: «Allí no se hospeda nadie desde hace muchos años», respondió ella sin levantar la vista.
sentences.en: “No one has stayed there for many years,” she replied without looking up.

annotations.explanation: Sin followed by an infinitive describes how an action happens.

sentences.es: Daniel no sabía si creerle, aunque tampoco quería parecer un huésped difícil.
sentences.en: Daniel did not know whether to believe her, although he did not want to seem like a difficult guest.

annotations.explanation: Si introduces an indirect yes/no question. Le refers to Rosa.

sentences.es: Más tarde encontró una fotografía de su padre: mostraba el hotel, el mar y una joven junto a la ventana del segundo piso.
sentences.en: Later he found one of his father’s photographs: it showed the hotel, the sea, and a young woman beside a second-floor window.

sentences.es: En el reverso alguien había escrito: «Clara, habitación doce, febrero de 1987».
sentences.en: On the back someone had written: “Clara, room twelve, February 1987.”

sentences.es: Daniel llevó la fotografía al comedor, donde Rosa estaba colocando flores en una mesa.
sentences.en: Daniel took the photograph to the dining room, where Rosa was arranging flowers on a table.

sentences.es: Al verla, la mujer se quedó inmóvil y después se sentó frente a él.
sentences.en: When she saw it, the woman froze and then sat down across from him.

sentences.es: Le explicó que Clara era su hermana y que había desaparecido durante una tormenta, sin dejar ninguna nota.
sentences.en: She explained that Clara was her sister and had disappeared during a storm, leaving no note.

annotations.explanation: This event occurred before Rosa told Daniel the story.

sentences.es: Durante décadas, Rosa había mantenido cerrada la antigua habitación de su hermana porque temía olvidar su voz.
sentences.en: For decades, Rosa had kept her sister’s former room closed because she feared forgetting her voice.

annotations.explanation: Temer plus infinitive expresses fear of an action.

sentences.es: Daniel miró otra vez la foto y descubrió un detalle que antes no había visto.
sentences.en: Daniel looked at the photograph again and discovered a detail he had not noticed before.

annotations.explanation: The pluperfect connects an earlier lack of noticing with a later discovery.

sentences.es: Sobre la mesa, detrás de Clara, había una pequeña grabadora con una cinta puesta.
sentences.en: On the table, behind Clara, there was a small tape recorder with a cassette inside.

sentences.es: Rosa abrió un cajón, sacó una caja y encontró una cinta con la misma fecha.
sentences.en: Rosa opened a drawer, took out a box, and found a cassette with the same date.

sentences.es: No lo explicaba todo, pero por primera vez tenían algo que podían escuchar juntos: una voz que seguía allí.
sentences.en: It did not explain everything, but for the first time they had something they could listen to together: a voice that was still there.

annotations.explanation: Seguir expresses continuation; here the voice continues to exist in the recording.
annotations.tip: Seguir + gerund means “to keep doing something.” Here seguir stands alone.

sentences.es: Cuando Daniel regresó a su cuarto, la puerta doce tenía de nuevo su número de latón.
sentences.en: When Daniel returned to his room, door twelve once again bore its brass number.

comprehension.question: Why does Daniel come to the coast?
comprehension.explanation: He comes to sort through the photographs his late father left behind.

comprehension.question: Who is Clara?
comprehension.explanation: Rosa explains that Clara was her sister.

comprehension.question: What new clue appears in the photograph?
comprehension.explanation: Daniel notices a tape recorder behind Clara in the old photograph.
